command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
BACKING_DIR=/var/lib/btrfs-backing
IMG="$BACKING_DIR/data.img"
ADMIN_MNT=/srv/.btrfs-admin
DATA_MNT=/srv/data

echo "== STEP1: backing store =="
sudo -n mkdir -p "$BACKING_DIR"
sudo -n fallocate -l 2G "$IMG"
sudo -n modprobe btrfs
echo "btrfs" | sudo -n tee /etc/modules-load.d/btrfs.conf >/dev/null

echo "== STEP2: mkfs.btrfs =="
sudo -n mkfs.btrfs -f -L srvdata "$IMG"

echo "== STEP3: admin mount + subvolume current =="
sudo -n mkdir -p "$ADMIN_MNT" "$DATA_MNT"
sudo -n mount -o loop "$IMG" "$ADMIN_MNT"
sudo -n btrfs subvolume create "$ADMIN_MNT/current"
sudo -n mkdir -p "$ADMIN_MNT/snapshots"
sudo -n btrfs subvolume list "$ADMIN_MNT"
sudo -n umount "$ADMIN_MNT"

echo "== STEP4: fstab + mount /srv/data =="
grep -qF "$IMG $DATA_MNT" /etc/fstab || echo "$IMG $DATA_MNT btrfs loop,subvol=current,nofail 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
sudo -n mount "$DATA_MNT"

echo "== VERIFY =="
mount | grep -E "btrfs|$DATA_MNT"
df -hT "$DATA_MNT"
cat /etc/fstab | tail -3

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
DATA_MNT=/srv/data
ADMIN_MNT=/srv/.btrfs-admin
IMG=/var/lib/btrfs-backing/data.img

echo "== STEP5: populate application data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p "$DATA_MNT/app/config" "$DATA_MNT/app/logs" "$DATA_MNT/app/db"
printf 'app_name=widgetsvc\nport=8080\nmode=production\n' | sudo -n tee "$DATA_MNT/app/config/app.conf" >/dev/null
printf 'record1,record2,record3\n42,43,44\n' | sudo -n tee "$DATA_MNT/app/db/data.csv" >/dev/null
printf '2026-09-29T07:00:00 startup ok\n' | sudo -n tee "$DATA_MNT/app/logs/app.log" >/dev/null
sudo -n find "$DATA_MNT" -type f | sort

echo "== STEP6: baseline manifest before snapshot =="
sudo -n find "$DATA_MNT" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sudo -n sed "s#$DATA_MNT/##" | sort > /tmp/baseline_manifest.txt
sudo -n cp /tmp/baseline_manifest.txt /root/baseline_manifest.txt
cat /tmp/baseline_manifest.txt

echo "== STEP7: take read-only snapshot 'baseline' =="
sudo -n mount -o loop "$IMG" "$ADMIN_MNT"
sudo -n btrfs subvolume snapshot -r "$ADMIN_MNT/current" "$ADMIN_MNT/snapshots/baseline"
sudo -n btrfs subvolume list "$ADMIN_MNT"
sudo -n umount "$ADMIN_MNT"

echo "== STEP8: modify live data (simulate change) =="
sudo -n sh -c "printf 'app_name=widgetsvc\nport=9090\nmode=debug\n' > $DATA_MNT/app/config/app.conf"
sudo -n rm -f "$DATA_MNT/app/db/data.csv"

sudo -n find "$DATA_MNT" -type f | sort

echo "== STEP9: manifest after modification (expect diff) =="
sudo -n find "$DATA_MNT" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sudo -n sed "s#$DATA_MNT/##" | sort > /tmp/modified_manifest.txt
cat /tmp/modified_manifest.txt
